title: His Love Endures Forever
story:
A man once went through many difficult seasons in life.

He lost his job.

Faced financial struggles.

And went through personal disappointments.

During that time, he stopped noticing small blessings.

One day, an old friend visited him.

The friend brought simple food and shared it with him.

After the meal, the friend said,

“Let’s write down what you still have, not what you lost.”

Reluctantly, the man began listing things.

He realized he still had life.

Health.

Family.

Hope.

Gratitude slowly returned to his heart.

He understood that even in hardship, goodness was still present.

In life, we often focus on what is missing.

But God’s goodness never stops.

His love never ends.

And every moment is an opportunity to give thanks.
life_lesson: God is always good, and His love never ends.
prayer:
Dear Heavenly Father,

Thank You for Your constant goodness.

Help me to remember Your blessings even in difficult times.

Teach me to live with a thankful heart.

Let my life always give You praise.

In Jesus' name,
Amen.
reflection_question:
Are you focusing more on what is missing than what God has given?

What blessings can you thank God for today?

How can you develop a more grateful heart?
verse:
Give thanks to the Lord, for He is good;
His love endures forever.
